results.title: Growth of the Soil
results.overview: It is late autumn. Isak fights to survive in the wilderness. One day, Inger appears over the mountain. Out of a meeting in need, love grows. In merciless nature, Isak and Inger fight to create a life together. With love as their driving force, they build the farm Sellanraa from nothing. When a dark secret comes to the surface, love is put to the test.

results.title: Secrets in a Small Georgia Town
results.original_title: Secrets in a Small Georgia Town
results.overview: A corrupt sheriff arrests a woman for killing the man who was sexually assaulting her young daughter. Determined to stand up to the town's power structure, she decides to run against the sheriff in a local election while awaiting her day in court.

results.title: Castration Movie Chapter iii.ii Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
results.original_title: Castration Movie Chapter iii.ii Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
results.overview: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

results.title: Ghosts
results.overview: Logi, in the midst of a heartbreak spends time with his two best friends and meets a girl that gives him a new perspective on love

results.title: Sahan
results.overview: Imran Sheikh is a man of dual identities, maintaining a polished, gentlemanly image in public while harboring a volatile nature behind closed doors. His wife, Nusrat, finds herself trapped in a cycle of constant adaptation, struggling to satisfy his increasingly unpredictable and suffocating demands. Despite the growing emotional toll, she remains dedicated to saving their crumbling marriage through sheer endurance. However, her efforts to maintain peace eventually reach a breaking point as the domestic friction escalates. What began as a desperate attempt at harmony soon spirals into a dark and dangerous reality, as things take a sudden, ugly turn.

results.title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
results.original_title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
results.overview: The tomatoes resurface, and this time the enemy is artificial. When Professor Gangreen’s young corporate prodigy goes rogue, the tomatoes start thinking for themselves. The vine gets smarter. The vine gets faster. The vine, for the first time, gets a plan.

results.title: In Dreaming
results.overview: Ryan is destined to dance, but has to put his passion aside to fulfil his duties at his family’s nail salon.

results.title: I'm Undercover
results.overview: To solve an undercover case pending for many years, the old police chief Situ Qiang sends police officer Huo Tao, who is desperate to raise funds for his daughter's medical treatment, to go undercover in a criminal gang. Huo Tao pretends to be a pickpocket and gains the trust of the gang leader, Lord Bei, and gets acquainted with a young pickpocket named Xiaofei. Cooperating with the police's plan, he discovers Lord Bei's collusion with others to steal business secrets. Finally, all the criminals are brought to justice, fulfilling Situ Qiang's wish.

results.title: Sunday Boyfriends
results.overview: In the chaotic sprawl of Mexico City, a Venezuelan immigrant navigates a cycle of failed dates and binge eating to fill the void of a lost relationship, only to realize that reclaiming his own joy is a radical act of resistance worth fighting for.

results.title: Dance of the Living
results.overview: On the arid island of Fuerteventura, Miguel and his daughter Mariana struggle to move forward after his wife’s death, a loss that has set them adrift. Traditional wrestling is all they know, their way of making a place in the world. But Miguel’s body is failing him, and Mariana’s anger is pushing her to break the rules. As the championship final approaches, father and daughter find themselves on uncertain ground, searching for a way back to each other before it’s too late.

results.title: Niko
results.overview: In the troubled night of Seoul on the verge of apocalypse, Niko, a penniless scriptwriter, works a part-time job as a companion for people who have lost their keys. When she can no longer satisfy her longing for true love in this once melancholic, sensual, and bustling city, she disappears. Her boyfriend Jeremy and their new friend Ji-eun start looking for the missing Niko and become entangled in a love triangle. At last, Niko finds a new, reckless, and ultimate way to express her feelings.

results.title: Casa Pura
results.overview: Joaquín is a man who, in the aftermath of Hurricane Maria, fights to save Casa Pura, the boutique hotel that once stood as his greatest pride. That fragile stability is threatened when his sister-in-law returns to the island with a buyer—and unexpectedly, a long-lost will that could change everything. From that moment on, a race against time begins to protect not just a property, but the emotional and family legacy that still holds him together.

results.title: La Moula
results.overview: Thanks to Charlie, a cocaine trafficker, and his gangster associates, Jérôme, a struggling organized crime reporter, sees an opportunity to reboot his career. While waiting for a drug shipment near Marseille, the possible presence of a cop puts them all in danger…

results.title: Sathi Leelavathi
results.overview: Leelavathi is a successful and spirited film director whose marriage with Ram Sethu begins falling apart. The relationship is strained by ego, changing gender roles, and the husband feeling overshadowed by his wife's success. Things complicate further when Sethu asks for a divorce and admits he has feelings for another woman, Nicola Sebastian. The couple is then forced to confront unresolved feelings and unearth hidden truths about their marriage.

results.title: Magazine
results.overview: A young intern faces intoxicating power dynamics at a prestigious New York City literary magazine.

results.title: Albin de la Simone, Jozef Dumoulin & Fabrice Moreau @ Jazz sous les Pommiers 2026
results.original_title: Albin de la Simone, Jozef Dumoulin & Fabrice Moreau Jazz sous les Pommiers 2026
results.overview: A leading figure in French music, Albin de la Simone revisits his repertoire alongside Jozef Dumoulin and Fabrice Moreau. These songs are waiting to be rediscovered through the lens of jazz at Jazz sous les Pommiers.

results.title: The Last Tupper
results.overview: Gabriel, a 65-year-old man marked by the loss of his wife Alicia, faces the challenge of rebuilding his life after the arrival of Yuqi, a new tenant, and reconnecting with his daughter Lidia, with whom he has a distant relationship.

results.title: Another Man
results.overview: Marc and Eudald have been in a stable relationship for six years. Their life seems to run smoothly but even though together they make a good team, Eudald’s increasing impatience to cement their relationship is starting to get to to Marc, who finds himself caught in an emotional deadlock.
